formalModel.name: Unified Context-Conditioned OSS Ecosystem Propagation Model
formalModel.ecosystem: M_E = ({G_p}_{p=1..K}, C_s, mu, X, S, Lambda, Alpha, Q, Pi)

definitions.G_p: Directed dependency graph for product p.
definitions.C_s: Set of empirically studied shared components; components may be shared nodes or shared exact dependency edges.
definitions.mu: mu(c) is the set of products containing shared component c.
definitions.rho: rho_c = |mu(c)| / K, the topological ecosystem reach of component c.
definitions.x: Execution context, including workload and/or configuration.
definitions.lambda: lambda_c(s) is a natural occurrence/failure rate if defensibly estimated from external or longitudinal evidence; currently unestimated.
definitions.alpha: alpha_c(p,x) = P(A_c=1 | T_c(p)=1, x), context-conditioned activation.
definitions.q: q_c(p,x,s) = P(I_c=1 | A_c=1,p,x,s), propagation conditional on activation.
definitions.pi: pi_c(p,x,s) = alpha_c(p,x) * q_c(p,x,s), effective controlled impact.

formalModel.noScalarRiskYet: No single ecosystem risk scalar is claimed because lambda is unestimated and the current perturbations are controlled mechanisms rather than natural incident frequencies.
